description: Bedford, VA — Congressman Morgan Griffith has declined Democratic nominee Joy Powers’ challenge to participate in three public debates across Virginia’s Ninth Congressional District before the November election.In a letter to Powers, Griffith wrote that “the people of the Ninth District already know where I stand” and said he would rather spend the fall “listening” to voters than “trading rehearsed lines” with Powers on a stage.“Morgan Griffith says he would rather spend the fall ‘listening’ to
